title: usagePreviewStyle
responsibility: The inline style that places a usage preview beside its link within its owning card, or null once the link is off screen.

inputs.name: usagePreviewStyle.root
inputs.description: The element containing the usage link. Its first descendant anchor is measured when present; otherwise the root itself is measured.

inputs.name: usagePreviewStyle.tip
inputs.description: The preview element whose width is set to the available horizontal space before its scroll height is measured. The function does not restore the previous width.

inputs.name: usagePreviewStyle.view
inputs.description: The viewport width and height used for the off-screen check and placement. The function uses these values directly without validating them.

outputs.name: usagePreviewStyle
outputs.description: When the measured link is on screen, this returns inline CSS for left, top, width, and optional max-height; width is based on horizontal room bounded by 8px edges and capped at 280px, and left is clamped to that room. It returns null when the link bottom is below 0 or its top exceeds view.height.
